nodes.title: Chapter seals on the Kaksha World and in the Debrief come from the ledger's own flag (/api/child/map chapters[].sealed, server/routes/child.js buildMap: every skill Got it or Secure), never from an app count: the World lists sealed chapters; the Debrief shows 'Chapter sealed' for chapters that flip unsealed→sealed between the lesson-open and lesson-end map reads (nowSealed), so a seal shows in the lesson that sealed it. Learning is asked for sealedAt (first-seal time) so a dip-and-reseal never shows twice, secureSince (K-P5), and a server equip route. Reverse: the seal moves to a Conductor milestone event.

md.decisions:
## `dc-r7-app-chapter-seals`
Finishing a chapter now has a moment. When the ledger says every idea in a chapter is the child's own, the lesson that got them there ends with 'Chapter sealed', and the World keeps a row of sealed chapters. The app never counts its way to a seal: it only shows the server's own judgement, read before and after the lesson.
